data.name: 24-Hour Urine Collection for Copper and Molybdenum

code.decode: Volume measurement for timed collection, each

data.label: 24-Hour Urine Collection
data.description: For each 24-hour collection period, urine will be pooled for analysis and volumes will be recorded. Copper and molybdenum concentration (ng/mL) of each 24-hour urine sample will be determined by ICP-MS.

name.quote: Urine samples to measure copper and molybdenum content will be collected periodically as described in the SoA

description.quote: For each 24-hour collection period, urine will be pooled for analysis and volumes will be recorded. All sample handling procedures will be documented in detail as described in the Laboratory Manual. Copper and molybdenum concentration (ng/mL) of each 24-hour urine sample will be determined by ICP-MS.

data.name: Fecal Collection for Copper and Molybdenum

code.decode: Sputum, obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Fecal Sample Collection
data.description: Fecal samples individually collected, weighed, and stored. Copper and molybdenum concentration (ng/g) of each stool sample will be determined by ICP-MS; each sample will be analyzed using a minimum of technical triplicates.

name.quote: Fecal samples to measure copper and molybdenum content will be collected periodically as described in the SoA

description.quote: Fecal samples will be individually collected, weighed, and stored. The weight and time of each bowel movement will be recorded. All sample handling procedures will be documented in detail in the Laboratory Manual. Copper and molybdenum concentration (ng/g) of each stool sample will be determined by ICP-MS; each sample will be analyzed using a minimum of technical triplicates.

data.name: Food and Fluid Sample Collection for Copper and Molybdenum

code.decode: Biospecimen Collection

data.label: Food and Fluid Collection
data.description: A minimum of 3 complete portions/meals from each food and liquid batch will be sent for analysis. Copper and molybdenum concentration of each food sample (ng/g) and each fluid sample (ng/mL) will be determined by ICP-MS.

name.quote: Samples of all meal and fluid batches will be collected and analyzed for measurement of copper and molybdenum content

label.quote: Food and Fluid Collection for Copper and Molybdenum Concentrations

description.quote: A minimum of 3 complete portions/meals from each food and liquid batch will be sent for analysis. All participants will drink water from the same large water bottle dispenser. Samples of water from this dispenser will be collected and analyzed for copper and molybdenum content.
